rule.name: Repeated failed logins followed by success from unfamiliar IP
rule.description: 50+ failed logins for one account within 15 minutes, then a successful login from an IP not seen for this account in the last 30 days.

summary: 50 failed logins against j.doe@example.com from 203.0.113.45 between 02:58 and 03:13 UTC, followed by a successful login from the same IP at 03:13:51 UTC. The IP has no prior history for this account.
